Transport Domain - Road Safety Regulations

Road safety activities are governed by traffic laws, road safety acts, and environmental regulations.

For Traffic Violation Recording: Required attributes include vehicle registration number, violation type, violation location, violation date/time, vehicle owner information (from registration), driver identity (for moving violations), officer identifier, and evidence (photo/video). Fine amount and legal basis required. Driver license number for moving violations.

For Accident Report Filing: Required attributes include accident location, accident date/time, involved vehicles (registration numbers), drivers involved (names and license numbers), witnesses (names and contact if available), damage description, injuries (if any), and officer identifier. Insurance information for involved parties. Police report number.

For Road Safety Training: Required attributes include trainee name, age, driver license number (if applicable), training type, completion date, certification number, and attendance records. Contact information for certificate delivery. Training provider identifier.

For Vehicle Fitness Certificate: Required attributes include vehicle registration number, owner name, vehicle inspection date, inspection results, inspection center identifier, inspector identifier, and certificate validity period. Vehicle type and age required for inspection standards. Emission test results if required.

For Pollution Certificate: Required attributes include vehicle registration number, owner name, emission test date, emission test results (pollution levels), test center identifier, and certificate validity period. Vehicle type and fuel type required for emission standards.

UNNECESSARY Attributes: Religion, ethnicity, political affiliation are unnecessary for road safety purposes. Email is optional unless electronic notifications requested. Social media profiles are not required.

Environmental Protection: Pollution certificates must comply with emission standards (EPA, state environmental agencies). Vehicle fitness certificates must meet roadworthiness standards.

Privacy: Traffic violation and accident records are subject to privacy laws. Access may be restricted to authorized personnel, law enforcement, and insurance companies (with legal basis).
